learning_outcomes.text: Can apply limit, continuity and differentiality rules to complex functions.
Can calculate the contour integration of complex functions.
Can interpret the Cauchy-Integral Theorem and its results
Can define and sample complex series.

syllabus_topics: Definition of complex numbers. Algebraic Properties Geometric interpretation. Properties of triangle inequality.
Polar form. Exponential form. Roots and powers. Region in complex plane.
Functions of complex variable. Elementary Functions, exponential functions.
Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Hyperbolic Functions, logarithmic function.
Formulas of Cauchy Riemann. Sufficient conditions.
Cauchy Gaursat Theorem. Cauchy Integral Formula.
bibliography: T.Başkan, Kompleks Fonksiyonlar Teorisi M.Başarır, Kompleks Değişkenli Fonksiyonlar Teorisi
